about: Flosendo decisions on upstream chenhg5/cc-connect commits (EDEN-1313 fork). Scored 9 Oct 2026 by Fati at Ivan's request ("only if it makes sense, and added value by scoring and looking at the cons and pros and consequences"). Verdicts: adopt | watch | declined | feature-off | have-equivalent | not-used | low-value. flosendo/upstream_report.py lists upstream commits not yet here.

961655de.subject: fix(core): count queued user messages toward reset_on_idle_mins
961655de.why: Queued messages restart the reset_on_idle_mins clock: reset_on_idle_mins is not set (resetOnIdle <= 0, off), and LastUserActivity is read by nothing else.

8804501d.subject: fix(core): stop clearing history on card-driven /switch
8804501d.why: History cleared after a /switch made from the /list card: our Slack platform has no interactive cards (no card-action handler; 0 block_actions events in the logs since 30 Sep), and a typed /switch already keeps the history. /list and /switch were not used (audit log since 30 Sep: /new 28, /stop 2).

93b3a5da.subject: fix(claudecode): use the context window Claude Code reports for ctx %
93b3a5da.why: ctx % from the window Claude Code reports. The bug is ours too (claude-opus-5-5 is measured against 200k; 79-93% of calls in three bridge sessions, 8-19 Oct, were over 200k, so the footer would read ctx 100%), but we never show that footer: our Slack turns finish through the streaming card, which carries none (472 of 504 turns since 30 Sep; 0 footers in the last 600 messages of #eden-dev, #eden-two and the Linear-only channel). Does not apply without c3a6a25e, which conflicts too. Take all three (c3a6a25e, 93b3a5da, 6ed762d3) only if the footer is ever shown.

Taking it is costly: it conflicts in agent/claudecode/session.go, core/engine.go and core/message.go, needs reportedCtxWindow and EventHookRejected (from 93b3a5da and 9355354f, neither taken), and writes to cs.events directly, which skips our orphan routing (emitEvent). It drops a human message whose text is empty and which has no files (platform/slack/slack.go:305), so a shared message or a native table would never reach the agent, and the logs cannot show that because such messages are dropped before anything is logged. Symptom that would make us take it: an agent missing a message Ivan shared or a table he pasted (none seen: 0 agent replies saying nothing came through). A test cherry-pick applies cleanly, but it changes what agents receive (attachment text, including link previews, is appended), so it needs Ivan.

80bdf304.subject: fix(claudecode): drop empty task-notification result on --resume; flush partial unsolicited text on cancel
80bdf304.why: It could hit us: we resume sessions (8 resumed spawns, 9-26 Oct) and agents leave long shell jobs running in the background. It has not happened: 0 of 355 turns ended empty (the smallest reply was 8 chars, a NO_REPLY). Symptom that would make us take it: a turn posted as an empty response after a resume. The core half's flushPartial posts text without unsolicitedOutbound, so it skips our NO_REPLY patch (a054387f), and it would start posting text from the 222 unsolicited streams that now end cancelled. If taken, only the claudecode half, or with the flush routed through unsolicitedOutbound. It conflicts in agent/claudecode/session.go and needs Ivan.

EDEN-1618.what: A message queued behind a busy session is never lost without its sender being told. Idle kill: the queue goes to a fresh session once the dead turn releases it, and alert_session_key hears of it. Reset (/new, /stop, a self-reset): each queued message gets 'Not processed (<why>): <first line>' in its own thread. Restart: Engine.Stop writes the queues to <data dir>/run/pending_queue_<project>.json; when a platform is ready again each sender gets the same notice in the message's thread (Slack: ReplyTargetKey). Every drop logs remaining_queue=0, and the drain log carries remaining_queue, so deploy.sh queued is right.
EDEN-1618.why: 19 Oct 2026: Ivan's 'sign 1' and ten numbered answers sat in such a queue for two hours and were lost to the idle kill; 6 queued messages were dropped 6 to 20 Oct (EDEN-1614 audit). Ivan, 20 Oct: 'promote 1618'.
files: core/engine.go (notifyDroppedQueuedMessages, the idle kill, Engine.Stop, onPlatformReady, the drain log, the alertSessionKey field)
EDEN-1618.upstream_conflict_risk: core/engine.go, five small hunks; an upstream change to notifyDroppedQueuedMessages, the idle-timeout case or Engine.Stop needs these re-applied.
